item.title: Pelorus: Resource-Aware Lidar-Inertial Odometry
item.description: Lidar-inertial odometry (LIO) has an efficiency problem. High-resolution lidars produce millions of points per second that must be processed online on the resource-constrained hardware of robots, cars, or drones, yet most LIO methods neither bound their memory nor report their compute footprint. We introduce Pelorus, a resource-aware LIO with a fixed-capacity multiresolution map of voxelized normal distributions and an iterated equivariant state estimator. A relevance-based eviction keeps the map memory bounded, and a maturity-weighted map update suppresses inconsistent observations. item.title: Colombo: A Frontier-to-Frontier Autoresearch System for Oracle-Based Optimization
item.description: Science advances from frontier to frontier as discoveries reshape what is known and create the basis for further discovery.
